top_10_fixes.fix: Stop generate_lead counting visits as results
top_10_fixes.what_to_do: Find what fires generate_lead on every page (often a tag set to fire on all pages) and fix its trigger, or stop counting it as a key event. Until then this audit counts sign_up only.
top_10_fixes.at_stake: no figure: it adds 22,895 false key events in 28 days, 35.8x the real sign-ups, so any report or bid on key events is wrong
top_10_fixes.evidence: generate_lead fired 22,895 times on 23,800 sessions (96.2%), so it counts visits, not results
top_10_fixes.who: do this in GA4 or the tag manager

top_10_fixes.fix: Cut LinkedIn Ads back to what returns sign-ups
top_10_fixes.what_to_do: Pause or narrow the LinkedIn campaigns until they show results near the target, and move the money to a channel at or under target.
top_10_fixes.at_stake: $2,980 above target in 28 days ($3,400 - 7 x $60) = 51.0 sign-ups at the blended paid cost of $58.45
top_10_fixes.evidence: get_account_analytics: $3,400, 7 results (5 website conversions + 2 lead-form leads), $485.71 each
top_10_fixes.who: do this in LinkedIn Campaign Manager

top_10_fixes.what_to_do: The landing page ranked 2 by sessions converts at under half the site rate, holds only 37.5% of visitors and paints its main content late on mobile. Speed it up and lead with the salon outcome and a sign-up button.
top_10_fixes.at_stake: 2,400 sessions x (2.7% site rate - 1.2% page rate) = 36.5 sign-ups in 28 days, if the page reached the site rate
top_10_fixes.evidence: landing page pull: 2,400 sessions, 28 sign-ups, engaged rate 37.5%; PageSpeed mobile LCP 3.6 s

top_10_fixes.fix: Fix or pause the Competitors campaign
top_10_fixes.what_to_do: Cut the competitor terms that don't convert, or pause the campaign, and give the budget to Clinics | Search.
top_10_fixes.at_stake: $1,940 above target ($2,600 - 11 x $60) = 33.2 sign-ups at the blended paid cost
top_10_fixes.evidence: campaign_performance_report: Competitors | Search $2,600 for 11 conversions ($236.36 each)
